title: High-Yield Savings Accounts vs CDs: Where to Park Cash Safely
bigPicture: Both options keep your money safe while earning a little extra, but they work best for different saving goals.
whatYouNeedToKnow: High-yield savings accounts let you add or take out money anytime and still earn good interest.
CDs lock your money for a set time, usually giving a higher rate if you can wait.
Choose based on when you might need the cash and how much extra return you want.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Putting emergency money in a CD and then needing it early, which can cause penalties.
Ignoring the fact that rates can change, so not checking for better offers after your term ends.
actionSteps: Compare current rates for high-yield savings accounts and CDs from trusted banks or credit unions.
Decide how long you can leave the money untouched, then open the account that fits your timeline and goals.
